scientific_scope_status: For a supplied unknown quadratic permutation Q on F2^n accessed by chosen-pair lexicographic comparisons and actual fresh native bits, acquired quadratic coordinate programs compute global or prefix-dependent affine checkpoints. The conditional frame constructor yields exact witness-conditioned prefix sampling during acquisition and a closed requested-output inverse after expiry, with parameter g_cond<=g and polynomial storage. Fixed bad-address mass<=1/1024 with arbitrary causal replies touching bad endpoints is tolerated by direct votes and a short-fibre win census; the logical comparison ceiling is3577*n*D_n*R. Internal failure delta*2^-n gives bounded-error expected bit/known-code work polynomial times(2^g_cond+delta), while worst-case work remains exponential.
